title: Snowman with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d0e8ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='20' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#b8d8f0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='15' fill='#f0f8ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#b8d8f0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Head snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#b8d8f0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x='36' y='23' width='28' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <rect x='36' y='23' width='28' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff7777'/>

  <!-- Hat top -->
  <rect x='40' y='8' width='20' height='16' rx='3' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <rect x='40' y='8' width='20' height='4' rx='3' fill='#ff7777'/>
  <rect x='40' y='18' width='20' height='3' fill='#cc2222'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='2' fill='#4444cc'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='31' r='2' fill='#4444cc'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='30.5' r='0.8' fill='#aaccff'/>
  <circle cx='55.5' cy='30.5' r='0.8' fill='#aaccff'/>

  <!-- Carrot nose -->
  <polygon points='50,35 50,38 57,36.5' fill='#ff8800'/>
  <polygon points='50,35 57,36.5 50.5,36.5' fill='#ffaa44'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M42,39 Q50,46 58,39' fill='none' stroke='#4444cc' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='37' r='2.5' fill='#ffaaaa' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='37' r='2.5' fill='#ffaaaa' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#4444cc'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#4444cc'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='1.8' fill='#4444cc'/>

  <!-- Scarf -->
  <path d='M36,44 Q50,50 64,44 Q64,48 50,52 Q36,48 36,44 Z' fill='#44cc44'/>
  <path d='M36,44 Q50,50 64,44' fill='none' stroke='#22aa22' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='58' y='46' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='#44cc44'/>
  <rect x='58' y='46' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#22aa22' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <rect x='58' y='54' width='6' height='3' fill='#22aa22'/>

  <!-- Stick arms -->
  <line x1='35' y1='52' x2='20' y2='44' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='23' y1='42' x2='20' y2='44' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='20' y1='44' x2='18' y2='48' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <line x1='65' y1='52' x2='80' y2='44' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='77' y1='42' x2='80' y2='44' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='80' y1='44' x2='82' y2='48' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
